# GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) as the authoritative repository development guide. Read it before changing skills, helper scripts, tests, documentation, or plugin distribution metadata.

Pay particular attention to independent plugin packaging for each skill, backward compatibility with the skills CLI, trust boundaries, least-privilege GitHub operations, and the repository's exact testing and release conventions.

These are instructions for **developing the repository**, not additional behavior to inject into the distributed skills.
